# Vibelly

> Vibelly (https://vibelly.fun) is a free, browser-based random video chat for adults 18+, run by Naimish Omar. Users are matched with strangers worldwide for video or text chat, with no account needed to chat. Free video is 480p. Vibelly Premium (from ₹9 a day, ₹49 for 30 days, or ₹499 a year) adds gender and country filters, 720p HD video, and voice-only calls. Every call has a Report button; reporting requires a Google or GitHub sign-in, reports are reviewed by hand, and signed-in accounts that break the rules are banned. Guests cannot be reported. Calls are encrypted in transit and never recorded. Signed-in members can also join groups and watch live streams; paid streams are run only by creators verified by hand, viewers pay the creator through Razorpay or UPI, and Vibelly keeps a share. Stream payments are separate from Premium. Vibelly is based in India.
